notes.title: 《塌方 Landsilid》Release date notice
notes.content:
The eternal peace of the mountain gods will be broken by humans, who swarm endlessly, with their own agendas to dig up mountains, plunder resources, and build bases.  A story of hubris or piety or determination or hesitation, witnessed by you from July 13, 2024.  
We recommend that you use the power of the cave to destroy all objectionable people and things, and also suggest that you pretend to be one of them to meet the objectionable people and things.  
But don't save money!  Never heard of God being short of money.  
And don't try to attack businessmen!  According to the ancient sacred covenant, you can't hurt a merchant who is the descendant of a devout believer, but it doesn't matter if he's not.  
And you can't hurt rabbits. We're still working on the hunting feature.  
...  Unless individual rabbits are willing to attack.
